hero.title: Gram Panchayat Certificates & Forms
hero.description: Find application forms and information about certificates required by citizens.

intro.title: Gram Panchayat Certificates & Applications
intro.description: Find information about applications for birth, death, marriage, property and other essential services.

birthRegistration.title: Birth Registration Certificate
birthRegistration.description: Prescribed application form for registering a child's birth in the Gram Panchayat records.

deathRegistration.title: Death Registration Certificate
deathRegistration.description: Application for registering a person's death and obtaining the relevant certificate.

marriageRegistration.title: Marriage Registration
marriageRegistration.description: Application form for registering a marriage and submitting the marriage memorandum as per applicable rules.

sample8A.title: Form 8(A) Extract
sample8A.description: An extract showing property assessment and relevant records for a house or land.

bplCertificate.title: Below Poverty Line (BPL) Certificate
bplCertificate.description: Official certificate regarding inclusion in the BPL list. Confirm the applicable list and eligibility with the office.

noDuesCertificate.title: No Dues Certificate
noDuesCertificate.description: Application for a certificate confirming that no dues are outstanding, for election or loan-related purposes.

toiletUsageCertificate.title: Toilet Usage Certificate
toiletUsageCertificate.description: Certificate confirming that a household has and uses a toilet. It may be required for government schemes.

constructionPermission.title: Construction Permission / NOC
constructionPermission.description: Application seeking Gram Panchayat permission for new house construction or repair work.

process.title: How to Apply for a Certificate
process.description: Follow these general steps when applying for a Gram Panchayat certificate.
process.stepOne: Identify the certificate or application you require.
process.stepTwo: Check the required documents with the concerned office.
process.stepThree: Submit the application with the required documents at the Gram Panchayat office.
process.stepFour: Check the application status and receive the certificate as prescribed.

note.title: Important Information
note.description: Required documents, fees and procedures may differ for each certificate. Before submitting an application, confirm the requirements and availability of the official form with the Gram Panchayat office.
